author: y. a. hill
title: Pete Sessions highlights Taiwan democracy anniversary and promotes NEWSMAX appearances
text:
Pete Sessions, U.S. Congressman representing Texas’ 17th district since 2021, marked the anniversary of a significant milestone in Taiwan’s democratic history and promoted his appearances on NEWSMAX through several posts on his social media account.
On March 23, 2026, Sessions acknowledged Taiwan’s political progress, stating, “Today marks the 30th anniversary of Taiwan’s first direct presidential election, a milestone in its transition to full democracy. For three decades, Taiwan has demonstrated the strength of its democratic institutions through peaceful transfers of power, standing as a beacon of”.
Later that day, Sessions invited followers to tune in to his television appearance: “Watch me on National Report on @NEWSMAX tomorrow at 9:35 AM EST! https://t.co/Glek0PLW56”.
The following morning, he posted again about his engagement with the network: “Starting the day right with @NEWSMAX! https://t.co/Ybot0vHOrk”.
Sessions has represented Texas’ 17th district since replacing Bill Flores in 2021. He was born in Waco, Texas in 1955 and continues to reside there at age 68. In recent elections, Sessions won against Mark Lorenzen in 2024 with over 66% of the vote and previously defeated Mary Jo Woods and Rick Kennedy in earlier cycles.
